Sample Descriptive Statistics

In this file, we’ll import all of the Virginia DJJ files provided and create preliminary cross-tabulations and merges to explore basic counts, trends, and double check primary keys and joins across the data files.

See Codebooks and Data Diagram tabs for more information on each individual data file.


Sample Descriptives

Data Sample:

  • Juvenile intake complaints with intake dates from July 1, 2015 - June 30, 2021

  • Dispositions – all dispositions for the intake complaints in the sample.

  • Caseload – all intake complaints in the sample that are associated with a workload status for diversion - “Diversion At Intake” or “Diversion Program Beyond 90 Days”
